## Objetivo
Build setup, invite-registration and sign-in screens against T08's existing API. Add the shared semantic product shell, navigation and reusable styled controls used by subsequent feature tasks. Do not alter server security or the private-route test infrastructure.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] Account screens call the existing setup, registration, session and logout APIs. Programmatic labels, visible keyboard focus, consistently styled controls and actionable validation errors are present; failed validation preserves non-secret input. Authenticated navigation exposes only implemented features and never fabricates product data. Shared controls and warm neutral/forest-green style tokens are reused across account screens.
- [ ] Playwright at 1280x720 and 390x844 covers first-member setup, invite registration, logout/sign-in and rejected credentials using isolated test data. Tests assert the authenticated/unauthenticated UI transitions, visible errors and no document horizontal overflow. They reuse T01 diagnostics for pageerror/console.error and failure text, wait for conditions without fixed sleeps, and capture descriptive viewport-only screenshots of account screens and post-interaction states after scrolling the relevant element into view.
- [ ] Fast tests in the existing Node suite cover any pure client validation or response-mapping logic introduced here. npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run build pass; npm test && npm run test:e2e includes the account journeys and existing infrastructure smoke tests. Security and private-API rejection coverage remains owned by T08.
